sections.text:
هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات الفحص و الاختبار السنوي الخاص بنظام الاطفاء التلقائي بالمياه 
بالمحولات الرئيسية و المساعدة .

أعد 
المسودة الأولية المهندس/ أحمد محمد المهتدي قمرة و اختبرها المهندس/ 
عبد المجيد الحناوى و راجعها المهندس/ السعيد شعبان عبد القادر والمهندس/حسام الدين 
الديفى ووافق عليها السيد المهندس/ 
مجدى عقبة مدير 
عام شئون المحطة
و 
اعتمدها السيد المهندس/ 
أحمد عبد المجيد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء 
النوبارية.
راجعها و وافق على المستند الكيميائي/ ابراهيم يوسف يوسف سليمان مفتش السلامة و 
الصحة المهنية بقطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة و وافق على المستند المهندس/ سمير 
عبد الجليل أحمد مدير عام التفتيش الفني بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء ومنسق الشركة لنظام معلومات اجراءات الصيانة ووثق من السيد المهندس/ محمد نجيب عبد 
الحي رئيس قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء.

items:
اصدار 
 أمر شغل معتمد من الجهه المختصة و يجب أن يحمل القائمون بأعمال الصيانة كارت 
 فئة السلامة و الصحة المهنية.

تسوير المكان لتحديد منطقة العمل و كذلك وضع 
 علامات التحذير

اتباع اجراءات السلامة و الصحة المهنية للأفراد 
 و المعدات و ارتداء مهمات الوقاية الشخصية (خوذة آمان- حذاء آمان اوفرول- 
 جوانتي.......).

rows: تأكد من أن المحول خارج الخدمة و عليه أرضى من الجهتين .
تأكد من ملاحظة الأجزاء الأساسية للنظام.

تأكد أن نظام
 الاطفاء في وضع التشغيل الطبيعي من خلال لوحة الحريق.
تأكد أن الموقع مهيأ لآداء التجربة و تفريغ المياه.
تاكد أن العدادت في حالة جيدة.
تأكد أن بلف البداية الرئيسي مغلق
تأكد من ضغط مياه مصدر الامداد

تأكد 
 من ضغط المياه بالنظام.
تأكد أن الانذار صالح و يعمل
فحص بلف التصفية الرئيسي.
فحص بلف التصفية المساعد.

تشغيل نظام الاطفاء بالمياه على المحولات بأحدى الطرق الآتية:-
 تقريب
 مصدر لهب أو توصيل طرفي أحد المحسات حول المحول
 يد التشغيل يدوية
تأكد أن نظام الفصل الأوتوماتيك للمحول يعمل

تأكد أن تفريغ المياه يرسل الى اللوحة الفرعية 
 (ACP-003)

تأكد أن انذار انخفاض ضغط المياه يرسل الى اللوحة الفرعية 
 (ACP-003)
سجل الوقت حتى سماع الانذار الصوتي .

تأكد 
 من أن تسرب المياه من بلف 
 deluge 
 سريان كامل
تأكد أن حيز الطرد لا يوجد به انسداد أو اعاقة .
تأكد أنه لا يوجد ما يعيق توزيع المياه على الأسطح المراد حمايتها.
تأكد أن الرشاشات موضوعة بطريقة صحيحة و موجهه.

تأكد أن البلف الحاكم يفتح 
ويغلق بطريقة صحيحة.
تأكد أن انذار السريان يختفي بعد توقف السريان.

تأكد أن انذار ضغط المياه المنخفض يختفي بعد اعادة ضبط البلف 
 (reset)
تأكد أن الضغط أثناء الاختبار مشابه أثناء الحالة الطبيعية.
تأكد أن الضغط أعلى من أقل ضغط تصميمي.
ارجاع النظام كما كان سابقا

sections_en.text: This document outlines the steps of the annual inspection and testing of the automatic water fire-fighting system on the main and auxiliary transformers.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Din El-Dify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Station Affairs, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector. The document was reviewed and approved by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef Suleiman, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).

rows: Make sure the transformer is out of service and earthed from both sides.
Check the main parts of the system.
Make sure the fire-fighting system is in its normal operating mode through the fire panel.
Make sure the site is prepared for carrying out the test and draining the water.
Make sure the gauges are in good condition.
Make sure the main starting valve is closed.
Make sure of the water pressure of the supply source.
Make sure of the water pressure in the system.
Make sure the alarm is in working order.
Inspect the main drain valve.
Inspect the auxiliary drain valve.

Operate the water fire-fighting system on the transformers by one of the following methods:-
 bringing a flame source close, or connecting the terminals of one of the detectors around the transformer
 manual operation
Make sure the automatic tripping system of the transformer works.

Make sure the water discharge is signalled to the auxiliary panel 
 (ACP-003)

Make sure the low water pressure alarm is signalled to the auxiliary panel 
 (ACP-003)
Record the time until the audible alarm is heard.
Make sure the water leakage from the deluge valve is at full flow.
Make sure the discharge area has no blockage or obstruction.
Make sure nothing obstructs the distribution of water over the surfaces to be protected.
Make sure the sprinklers are placed correctly and aimed.
Make sure the control valve opens and closes correctly.
Make sure the flow alarm disappears after the flow stops.

Make sure the low water pressure alarm disappears after resetting the valve 
 (reset)
Make sure the pressure during the test is similar to that under normal conditions.
Make sure the pressure is above the minimum design pressure.
Return the system to its previous state.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the annual inspection and testing of the automatic water fire-fighting system on the main and auxiliary transformers.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Din El-Dify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Station Affairs, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector. The document was reviewed and approved by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef Suleiman, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Tool bag
Cleaning tools
Grease can
Procedures to be Carried Out
1. | Make sure the transformer is out of service and earthed from both sides.
2. | Check the main parts of the system.
3. | Make sure the fire-fighting system is in its normal operating mode through the fire panel.
4. | Make sure the site is prepared for carrying out the test and draining the water.
5. | Make sure the gauges are in good condition.
6. | Make sure the main starting valve is closed.
7. | Make sure of the water pressure of the supply source.
8. | Make sure of the water pressure in the system.
9. | Make sure the alarm is in working order.
10. | Inspect the main drain valve.
11. | Inspect the auxiliary drain valve.
12. | Operate the water fire-fighting system on the transformers by one of the following methods:-
 bringing a flame source close, or connecting the terminals of one of the detectors around the transformer
 manual operation
13. | Make sure the automatic tripping system of the transformer works.
14. | Make sure the water discharge is signalled to the auxiliary panel 
 (ACP-003)
15. | Make sure the low water pressure alarm is signalled to the auxiliary panel 
 (ACP-003)
16. | Record the time until the audible alarm is heard.
17. | Make sure the water leakage from the deluge valve is at full flow.
18. | Make sure the discharge area has no blockage or obstruction.
19. | Make sure nothing obstructs the distribution of water over the surfaces to be protected.
20. | Make sure the sprinklers are placed correctly and aimed.
21. | Make sure the control valve opens and closes correctly.
22. | Make sure the flow alarm disappears after the flow stops.
23. | Make sure the low water pressure alarm disappears after resetting the valve 
 (reset)
24. | Make sure the pressure during the test is similar to that under normal conditions.
25. | Make sure the pressure is above the minimum design pressure.
26. | Return the system to its previous state.
